verdict.rationale: Synthesia has an AI Assistant, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it accepts external MCP servers; the axis applies. The pack never documents that ability. The only MCP evidence describes Synthesia's own MCP server, which Claude and ChatGPT use to create and find videos. That is the server role, not the client capability this story asks about, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
